༄༅// dpal kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa'i yan lag drug pa smin grol dngos grub rab 'phel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo pha bla ma rigs brgya'i khyab bdag tshar pa chen po gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang mchog gi sprul sku byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' nam mkha' legs pa lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bka' drin mtshungs zla med pa'i zhal snga nas dang*/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba gnyis pa rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po'i rgyal tshab mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa thar rtse ba chen po byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med mchog dpon slob brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i zhabs la rtag tu phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// rang gzhan smin cing grol bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'dir gsung ngag nyams len gyi snying po dpal kyai rdo rje'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len nag 'gros su dgod pa la/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun rin chen rdo rje 'chang dbang gi /zhabs pad dri med spyi bos blangs byas te// dri med rgyud don mngon par rtogs pa'i mchog /mtshungs med brgyud pa'i gsung don bri bar bya// dpal kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang gi chu bo ma nub par thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas mngon par rtogs pa 'bring du bya ba yan lag drug pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bya ba la gnyis te/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po la gnyis te bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ mdang nub mo nyal ba'i rnal 'byor chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang la nyal/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal gyis langs te/ bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro na khrus bya/

mi 'gro na ma byas kyang nyes pa med/ stan bde ba la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas/ kha shar du bltas te 'dug la/ skyabs 'gro'i yul rnams mngon sum du dmigs te/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= /dam pa'i chos rnams la= /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= /zhes skyabs 'gro ci nus bya/ mjug tu/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dkon mchog gsum po 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam mo// de nas/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// shes rab snying brtse dang ldan pas// brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas byas te// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod de/ zhes kha che paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'ang snang*/ rje btsun rin po che'i gsung 'di bzhin bla ma gong ma'i thugs dam phyag len la mdzad ces tshar chen rin po che'i gsung nyi zer du gsal/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du snying po kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du kyai rdo rje'i lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum/

de nas/ bdag gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ 'di bzhin dgos pa rje btsun rin po che'i gsung ngag glegs bam du bshad ces nā gardzu nas gsungs/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ he ru ka'i sku gang*/ de nas dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur par bsam la/ ngag tu/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa mā ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bhā wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñca he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig yan ci nus bzlas nas rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar la/

mgon po gsung rgyun/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus shel sgong lta bur gyur par bsam/ rgyal dbang mchog gis lam zab phyi nang sbrel ma'i nyams len rdor sems song mtshams sgos kyi sems bskyed nas bzung btang ba slob bshad pa'i phyag len yin gsungs/ bdag gi bla ma dam pas skyabs sems 'phror lam zab kyi nyams len bya gsungs/ rang skad cig gis dpal kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ sems gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po de las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu la brgyan pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod pas spyan drangs/ na moḥgu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥshrī he badz+ra maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las lha mo rnams spros la mchod par bsams la/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ ngag tu/ nam mkhar rje btsun bltas nas ni// rdo rje skye ba snying rje che// rgyan rnams thams cad 'dzin pa yi// lha mo brgyad po rnams kyis mchod// dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag

/de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen pos rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces brjod/ de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ de nas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las ni ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma byin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum brjod/ de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyud dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms te bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas ye shes kyi tshogs gsag pa ni/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du bsgoms nas sngags 'dis byin gyis brlabs par bya ste/ oṃ shū n+yā tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ ser po las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba/ khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba go skabs med par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ 'khor lo'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs bcur pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/

dbus kyi nyi ma'i steng du bh+rūm̐ ser po phyogs bcur nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ re re/ de yang lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/ gzhan thams cad sngon po/ de thams cad so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa las dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba ser po la 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ shar du gshin rje'i gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du stobs po che sngon po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du hūm̐ mdzad sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu rang gi phyag rgyas thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ hūm̐ mdzad ma yin pa gzhan thams cad g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'phyar ba'i tshul du 'dzin cing g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dbus dang phyogs bzhi'i khro bo rnams brjid pa'i khro bo ste spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing bsgrad pa/ sku sbom zhing thung la gsus khyim che ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ khro bo gzhan rnams ni mdzes pa'i khro bo ste cung zad sgeg pa/ yid tsam khros pa sku skem zhing grims pa/ dbu skra nag po dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o// thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ zhes snang*/ skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa tshar chen rin po che'i gsung nor phreng du gsal/

mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma nas/ thugs rdo rje ma/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo bcu gcig srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa la ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes gsung rgyun/ de nas/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ni ri ti hūm̐ kham̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi ti hūm̐ kham̐ gis zhal bsil/ oṃ sarba saṃ shwa dha ni swā hās 'thor thung*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ mahā ar+ghaṃ pra tī tsa swā hās mchod yon/ badz+ra puṣ+pes me tog badz+ra dhū pes bdug spos/ ā lo kes mar me/ ghan+dhes dri chab/ nai wi d+yās zhal zas/ shab+das rol mos mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ zhes dang*/ lha mo bzhi'i sngags rgya byed pa tshar chen rin po che'i gsung nor phreng du gsal/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥnas/ wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gsung rgyun/ sngar bzhin mchod/ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ni ri nas shab+da'i

bar gsung rgyun/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gshin rje'i gshed la rnam par snang mdzad/ pad+ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ de nas lus bsrung zhing ming sba bar bya ste/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas rdo rje phra mo dpag tu med pas gtams par bsam/ de nas/ rang gi snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa gyen du langs pa/ de'i lte ba stong pa yod pa'i nang du rang gi sems hūm̐ gcig tu bsam/ de'i steng la sogs pa gang bsrung bar 'dod pa'i ming gi yi ge dang po bsam ste/ de yang bla ma bsrung bar 'dod na steng du/ rang nyid nang du/ spun zla g.yon du/ pha ma mdun du/ bu dang chung ma g.yas su/ 'khor g.yog rgyab tu/ nor rdzas rnams 'og tu bsam/ gang mi bsrung ba'i sa stong par bzhag go /de nas 'khor lo'i phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi rtsibs med pa'i bar du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bsgrub bya lus rid cing skra 'dzings pa/ kha nas khrag skyugs pa/ spyi bo tshugs su 'dug par bsams la/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros gnod byed kyi shes pa bkug la bsgrub bya de la bstim mo// de nas rang gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur bas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo rnams zhal phyir gzigs/ dbus dang steng 'og gi khro bo rnams zhabs g.yas brkyang du bsgyur/ 'khor lo g.yon du myur du 'khor bas gnod byed kyi lus rlung gis bskyod/ mes bsreg cing 'khor lo'i rtse mos nyal nyal gtub par bsam mo// de ltar gtubs pas kho'i tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs nas/

rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par bsam zhing sngags bzla bar bya'o// na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ na maḥs man+ta dharmā nāṃ/ na maḥs man+ta saṃ ghā nāṃ/ oṃ si tā ta pa tre/ oṃ bi mā la/ oṃ shaṅka ra/ oṃ pra t+yaṃ gi ra badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa tsakra warti/ sarba yan+t+ra man+t+ra/ mū la karma/ ban+dha naṃ/ tā ḍa naṃ/ ki la nāṃ wa/ ma ma kṛ te/ ye na ke na tsi ta/ kṛ tan+ta ta/ sarban+tu/ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ tsi ri tsi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ ma ra ma ra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ ces bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ brgya rtsa la sogs pa ci rigs pa bzla'o// gzhan yang*/ oṃ bha ya nā sa ni/ trā sa ni/ sarba mā ra pra t+yāṃ gi ra/ bi nā sa ni/ yi ge tsi ta duṣ+ṭān satwa/ ma ma bi rū pa kaṃ kurban/ ti tā ni/ sarba mā ra ṇi/ pra t+yaṃ kā ri ṇi/ pa ta tu hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa 'di yang bzla zhes 'dug pas bris pa yin la/ 'dir nges par bzla dgos pa ni ma yin no// de nas/ gang dag bdag cag la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ zhes snang yang*/ gsung rgyun la/ su gang dag bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ bdag cag la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ bsam pa dang sbyor ba ngan par byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig gal te zhi bar ma gyur na de'i tshe de dag thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o// ngag bcing bar bgyi'o// yid bcing bar bgyi'o// mthu brlag par gyur cig rdzu 'phrul brlag par gyur cig stobs brlag par gyur cig des bzlas pa'i sngags kyis de nyid brlag par gyur cig des bsgrubs pa'i lha 'dres de nyid kyi sha za bar gyur cig ces brjod cing*/ lus kyis thal mo brdab bo// de nas/ khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi// lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlogs// rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol// oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

zhes lan gsum gyis brtan par bsam pa ste bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la drug las/ dang po gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag ni/ rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba zhu ba las gzhi'i yan lag e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdengs kha che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ de'i nang du rgyu'i yan lag yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu chang zung dang mchog ma la yam̐ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du wam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa la wam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje phyed pa dang lte ba la lam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng gi bar snang la rkyen gyi yan lag oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdamar po gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa/ de las de 'dra ba'i sems kyi snang ba gcig chad pa 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa la thim/ de rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du nag po/ ljang gu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i mda' yab dang pu shus brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'o// nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/

dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang*/ 'phan dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar du gtum drag gi dur khrod/ lhor 'jigs byed thod pa can/ nub tu 'bar ba'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ byang shar du drag tu rgod pa/ shar lhor dbang phyug nags tshal/ lho nub tu 'jigs byed mun pa/ nub byang du kī li kī li'i sgra sgrogs pa/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing chen po brgyad ni/ shar du shī rī sha/ lhor tsu ta/ nub tu kaṃ ka la/ byang du a shat+tha/ byang shar du shing chen po/ shar lhor ka rañja/ lho nub tu 'khril shing can/ nub byang du ardzun rnams so// shing de dag gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba brgyad ni/ shar du brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa/ phyag g.yon na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang mdung 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na dbyug gu dang thod pa/ g.yon gnyis na spyi blugs dang phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po nag po ro langs la zhon pa/ g.yon thod pa dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ nu byang du rlung lha sngon po ri dwags la zhon pa/

g.yon thod pa dang ba dan 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang phyag g.yas kyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal ba'o// de dag gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin chen po brgyad ni shar du sgrog byed ser po/ lhor ldog byed sngon po/ nub tu 'jigs byed dkar po/ byang du 'khor byed ser po/ byang shar du 'thug po dkar po/ shar lhor 'gengs byed dmar po/ lho nub tu char 'bebs sngon po/ nub byang du gtum po sngon po'o// de dag la gnas pa'i klu chen po brgyad ni/ shar du nor rgyas ser po/ lhor pad+ma dkar po/ nub tu karko ṭa nag po/ byang du 'jog po dmar po/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po dkar po/ shar lhor hu lun+ta sngon po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan ljang gu/ nub byang du dung skyong ser po/ thams cad kyang sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan zhing*/ smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ stod lha'i lus can thal mo sbyar ba'o// shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong ba brgyad ni/ shar du lha'i dge 'dun dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he'i gdong pa can/ nub tu sprin gyi rgyal po dmar po chu srin gyi gdong pa can/ byang du gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon ser po rta'i gdong pa can/ byang shar du yi dwags 'dus pa dud kha glang gi gdong pa can/ shar lhor drang srong 'dus pa dmar po ra skyes kyi gdong pa can/ lho nub tu srin po'i tshogs can nag po ro langs kyi gdong pa can/ nub byang du rlung gi rgyal po ljang gu ri dwags kyi gdong pa can/ thams cad kyang shing lo'i gseb nas snying ga yan chad 'thon pa/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o// gzhan yang ro mgo bo bcad pa dang*/ dpyangs pa dang*/ bsnyal ba dang*/ gsal shing gis phug pa dang*/ mgo bo dang*/ keng rus dang*/ ce spyang dang*/ khra dang*/ khwa dang*/ 'ug pa dang*/ bya rgod dang*/ ro langs rnams phaiṃ zhes bya ba'i sgra sgrogs par byed pa/

ma lus pa rnams kyang sngon gyi grub thob rnams kyi mngon par rtogs pa las byung ba ste/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ smyo byed dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ sgrub pa po rnams dang bcas pa'i dur khrod kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngon po'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du nyon mongs pa la sogs pa/ bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nyer dbang sngon po/ byang du drag po nag po/ byang shar du gshin rje gshed sngon po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po nag po/ nub byang du thag bzangs ris dud kha rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nī la ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo skar ma'i rnam pa lta bu'i/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid mar me'i rnam pa lta bu'i/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa'i dpral bar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

de'i g.yon du am̐ las gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la am̐ gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i/ g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang ser po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal kha/ drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang gu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i ser mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa// rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje rngams dang zhi ba yi// gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa nyid// de'i pad na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/

g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskums pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'bru la āḥs mtshan pa/ oṃ pad+ma su kha dhā ra/ mahā rā ga su khaṃ da da/ tsa tur a nan+da/ bha ga bi shwa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kar+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā dwe ṣa/ tsa tur a nan+da/ da ya ka kha ga mu kha/ e ka ra so na tha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kar+yam̐ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgra ha ha si si/ kun dur+ha badz+ra dhṛka ces pa'i sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pas thig le chen po brgyad du gyur/ de rnams gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐/ zhes pa'i sa bon brgyad du gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu/ lha mo brgyad du gyur nas yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir 'thon te/ gdan so so'i steng du rim pa bzhin du 'khod pa ni/ shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau rī dmar mo g.yas cang te'u g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu be ta lī ser mo g.yas rus sbal g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas sprul g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du puk+ka sī sngon mo g.yas seṅge g.yon dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong g.yon gsil byed 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol ba mo sngon dmar g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thong gshol 'dzin pa/

nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// slar yang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bar snang nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdamar po gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa bkug yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i rkyen gyis yab yum rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas/ bdud bzhi'i steng du bde ba chen po'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gyi thig ler gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal gzung*/ de nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa'i phyir glus bskul ba ni/ rang gi shes pa mtshams kyi lha mo bzhir 'phos nas bskul bar bsam ste/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /puk+ka sī ni bdag la skyobs// stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spangs la// bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod// khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas// kyai yi rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spong la// ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod// dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba// stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci// khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas// gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid// bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal bgyi// mig 'khrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag nyid dran nyams pas// snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /ces bskul bas/ thig le de nyid hūm̐ dang am̐ sngon po 'od 'bar zhing 'jigs par gyur/

de zhu ba las bdag nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog sngon po/ zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar sngar bzhin bskyed/ yab kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐/ yum gyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du am̐/ lha mo brgyad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du/ gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐/ de rnams las 'od 'phros snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can la phog pas lha dgu'i ngo bor gyur/ de thams cad kyi mig tu mam̐ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar dam̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar pam̐ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ khar ram̐ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar am̐ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ snying gar nam̐ las bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ thugs kar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang mi mgo skam po'i phreng bas brgyan cing*/ ro'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par mos la/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pā ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing se gol brdab/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma zhes sogs kyis bstod nas/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas gau rī nag mo lcags kyu thogs pas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du spyan drangs/

oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes pas tsau rī dmar mo zhags pa thogs pas mgrin pa la reg pas ye shes pa smin mtshams nas thim/ oṃ badz+ra bai tā lī bhan+dha baṃ/ zhes pas bai tā lī ser mo lcags sgrogs thogs pas zhabs la reg pas dam tshig pa la ye shes pa chu la chu 'dres pa bzhin bsam/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes pas ghasma rī ljang gu dril bu thogs pas phyi nang kun dril bu'i sgra byung bas dam tshig pa rnams ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsam mo// gsum pa dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag ni/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ zhes brjod/ sngar bzhin/ dkar mo ri dwags/ zhes sogs lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rje bdag la stsol// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs// yid dang phrag dog chen po kun// rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mchog /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa// rdo rje can kun bdag dgyes mdzod// zhes pas bstod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyi// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur nas/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur/ rigs ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa// rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med// mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /lag pa rnam par snang mdzad brjod// ske rags la ni don yod gnas// yan lag kun la rdor 'dzin mgon// zhes brjod/ dbang gi chu rgyun des mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo/ am̐ las kyi phyag rgya/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/ hūm̐ chos kyi phyag rgya/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo/ oṃ phyag rgya chen po/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo/ ham̐ dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ zhes brjod/ dbang gi chu rgyun des snying ga yan chad gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ zhes brjod/ dbang gi chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis/ gau rī dang pūk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha wa rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ bai tā lī dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang ḍom+bhi nī la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do// bzhi pa bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag ni/

bdud rtsi dngos su 'byor ram ma 'byor na bsam pas kyang rung ste/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ swa bhā wā shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gis dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu brdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du shar du go las ba lang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ dbus su na las mi'i sha/ sha de rnams re re'i steng du yang bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa ni/ shar du bh+rūm̐ las dri chen/ lhor am̐ las rak+ta/ nub tu dz+rīṃ las byang sems/ byang du kham̐ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bh+rūm̐ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor am̐ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du kham̐ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon skor gyis/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ g.yas skor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bltas pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos/ me sbar bas sha lnga bdud rtsi rnams skol zhing 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song ste/ oṃ dang rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag

yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon nas/ rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa la thim pas rdo rje ljid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te/ kha dog dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs pa/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blangs te myangs la/ lha rnams kyi ljags la rdo rje nas 'bru tsam bsams la/ de bdud rtsi la zug myangs pas bde bas tshim par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ lnga pa mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams nas/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ sogs brjod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ drug pa bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag ni/ slar yang lha mo de rnams kyis bstod par bsam zhing*/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa// khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje sgrub pa'i yid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod de/ gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bsgoms pa'i lus kyi dbus su spyi gtsug nas lte ba'i bar la/ rtsa a wa dhu tī shin tu phra zhing gsal la thig le'i dwangs mas gang ba/

de'i g.yas su ro ma me'i rang bzhin rak+tas gang ba dmar po/ g.yon du rkyang ma chu'i rang bzhin byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba dkar po/ rtsa gsum gsal btab/ de nas a wa dhū tī la brtan pa'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte bar am̐ dmar po me'i rang bzhin mgo gyen du lta ba nang skor gyi 'dab ma brgyad la/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha/ phyi'i 'dab ma la ā li phrag gnyis g.yon bskor dang*/ g.yas bskor du kā li phrag gcig ha k+ṣa spangs pa/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte bar hūm̐ nag po mgo thur du lta ba/ phyogs bzhir bh+rūm̐ am̐ dz+rīṃ kham̐/ mtshams bzhir lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tam̐/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte bar oṃ dmar po mgo gyen du lta ba/ 'dab ma bcu drug la a li phrag gcig g.yon bskor dang*/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar ham̐ dkar po mgo thur du lta ba/ 'dab ma la a li phrag gnyis bsam mo// bshang sgor rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ sum mdor me'i dkyil 'khor yang bsgoms nas/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor ba byas la/ 'og rlung bskyod pas sum mdo'i me sbar/ des lte ba'i am̐ 'bar te/ me de g.yas ro ma nas yar song*/ snying ga dang mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab kyi yig 'bru rnams bsregs/ spyi gtsug gi ham̐ la phog ham̐ zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems g.yon rkyang ma nas babs/ des snying ga nas mgrin pa'i yig 'bru rnams gsos te/ mar byon nas thig pa lte ba'i am̐ la phog pas am̐ las me'i 'od zer shin tu phra ba gcig a wa dhū tī nas yar byon/ snying ga'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i oṃ bcom/ spyi gtsug gi haṃ la phog ham̐ zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems mu tig gi phreng ba'am 'o ma'i rgyun ltar babs/ mgrin pa'i oṃ dang snying ga'i hūm̐ gsos btab/ mar byon am̐ la phog

am̐ 'bar ba'i 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad la rlung kha sbyor bsgom mo// mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor bstan zin to// ༈ /gnyis pa mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la brgyad las/ ༈ /dag pa dran pa ni/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la// byams pa'i thugs la yan lag gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni// zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod// zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad// phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid// gug bskyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid// de nyid gsum ni spyan gsum mo// sha ni puk+ka sī ru brjod// de bzhin khrag ni ri khrod ma// gdol pa mo ni khu bar brjod// g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu dag /pags pa byang chub yan lag bdun// rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid// ces snang*/ dag pa dran pa/ dga' ston spring yig las 'byung ba ltar bya zhes tshar chen rin po che'i gsung nor phreng du gsal ba/ de'i don dga' ston spring yig las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dag pa dang*// gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te// zhes pa la sogs pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched kyi dag pa dran par bya ste zhes byung bas/ rje btsun rin po che'i gsung mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba 'di ltar te/ gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te// tshor ba la ni dkar mor brjod// 'du shes chu yi rnal 'byor ma// 'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// rnam shes phung po'i tshul gyis ni// bdag med rnal 'byor ma gnas so// sha ni puk+ka sī zhes brjod// de bzhin khrag ni ri khrod ma// gdol pa mo ni khu bar brjod// g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu ste// pags pa byang chub yan lag bdun// rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid// sa ni puk+ka sī zhes brjod// de bzhin chu ni ri khrod ma// me yi khams ni gdol pa mo// rlung gi khams ni g.yung mo nyid// zhe sdang zhes bshad rdo rje ma// ser sna gsang ba'i dkar mo nyid// 'dod chags chu yi rnal 'byor ma// phrag dog rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// gti mug de bzhin rdo rjer bshad// mig la gti mug rdo rje ma// rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma// sna la ser sna ma zhes bshad// kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma// lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma// yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma// gzugs la gau rīr rtag tu bshad// sgra yi cha la chom rkun ma// dri yi cha la ro langs ma// ro la ghasma rī rab grags// reg la sa spyod ma zhes brjod// chos kyi dbyings la mkha' spyod ma// zhes brjod cing dag pa dran par bya'o//

༈ /bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ bsnyen pa'i dus sam tshogs 'khor gyi dus su lha dgu ma bsdus pa'i skabs 'dir bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor byed pa yin la dus rgyun du ni lha mo brgyad bsdus te/ gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis bzlas pa bya'o// bsdu ba'i rim pa ni/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad srung ba'i 'khor lo la/ de dur khrod brgyad la/ de gzhal yas khang la/ de lha mo brgyad la/ de zhal brgyad la bsdu'o// bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ yum gyi thugs ka'i am̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ yum gyi zhal nas 'thon/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste/ yum gyi pad+mar zhugs nas sku'i dbyibs brgyud de/ yum gyi zhal nas byung*/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs nas rgyun mi chad par 'khor ba la dmigs la bzlas pa bya'o// de yang sngags kyi kha dog zhi ba la dkar po/ rgyas pa la ser po/ dbang la dmar po/ drag po la nag po bsgom/ de yang rgyun gyi bzlas pa dkar por bya'o// bsnyen pa la sogs pa'i skabs su 'khor gyi sngags bzla na/ 'khor ba'i dmigs pa sngar bzhin byas la/ sngags kyi 'od zer de lha mo gang gi bzlas pa byed pa'i lha mo de la phog pas/ de dbang du 'du zhing phrin las bskul bar bsam mo// bzlas pa'i dus su rang gi zhal thams cad dang*/ yum dang 'khor gyi zhal thams cad nas kyang sngags bzla bar bsams la bzlas/

zhes snang*/ slob bshad pa'i phyag len thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i gsung las/ bzlas pa'i skabs su/ rang kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i yab kyi thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ yum gyi thugs kar am̐ sngon po 'od kyi rang bzhin gsal btab pa'i yum gyi thugs ka'i am̐ gi klad kor las chu las chu 'bur rdol ba'i tshul gyis aṣ+ṭa'i sngags phreng gcig gi mjug la gcig 'thud pa mu men gyi phreng ba lta bu 'od kyi rang bzhin 'od dmar po lcags sgrog gis sgril ba lta bu dmar 'jig 'jig 'phro bzhin pa byung*/ yum gyi zhal nas 'thon/ rang kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs nas thur du thogs med kyis song*/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ zhabs kyu nas chu las chu 'bur rdol ba'i tshul du sngags phreng 'od dang bcas pa 'phros/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas byung*/ yum gyi pad+ma nas gyen du byung*/ thugs ka'i am̐ la thim pas chos thams cad stong nyid du thim song snyam pa'i ngang du sems gtad/ sngags phreng gi 'od dmar po lcags sgrog sgril ba lta bu des rang gi lus thams cad khengs pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ rang lhar gsal ba sngar bas shin tu gsal bar gyur/ 'od phyir 'phros nam mkha'i khams thams cad khengs pas/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' po mkha' 'gro nam mkha'i khams su til gyi gong bu kha bye ba ltar bzhugs pa thams cad mun khung du sgron me bteg pa bzhin du gsal lam gyis gyur/ yang 'od 'phros pas de dag thams cad dang*/ rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad dpal kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa de thams cad kyang sngags kyi sgra sgrog pa la cung zad sems gtad/ gtso bo ni sngags phreng 'khor ba kho na la sems gtad/ des dub pa'am stod 'tshangs pa lta bu byung na/

phar 'khor byas te/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags phreng 'phros zhal nas 'thon/ yum gyi zhal du song*/ thugs ka'i am̐ la thim/ am̐ las sngags phreng 'phros/ pad+ma nas byung*/ yab kyi rdo rje'i lam nas byung gyen du song*/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam bzhin pas sngags re dang dmigs pa sprod thub na rab/ tha ma sngags gsum gsum tsam la dmigs pa 'khor re med thabs med/ de la'ang dub na sngags kyi sgra tsam la sems gtad nas bzla bar bya ste/ mdor na sems rgya yan 'og 'gyu rgya 'byams kyi ngang du ji tsam bzlas kyang*/ 'bras bu mi 'byin pas sems dmigs pa dang ye ma bral bar bya ba gnad 'gag yin la/ dmigs pa'i gtso bo tshur 'khor ba nyid la gnad du bsnun/ dub pa sel ba'am gegs sel gyi tshul du phar 'khor dang*/ sgra tsam la sems gtad pa'ang skabs su bya ba yin gsung*/ bzlas bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ aṣ+ṭa na nā ya/ rab bsngags zhal brgyad pa la/ ping gaur+dha ke sha warta ma ne/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ tsa turbing+sha te ne trā ya/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa la/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ phyag bcu drug pa la/ kṛṣ+ṇa dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ char sprin nag po lta bu'i mdog can la/ ka pā la mā la a ne kām̐ dhā ri ṇe/ thod pa'i phreng ba du ma 'dzin pa la/ āt+ma ta krū ra tsit+tā ya/ khong nas 'khrugs pa'i thugs can la/ ar+dhen+tu daṃ ṣ+ṭi ṇe/ zla ba phyed pa lta bu'i mche ba can la/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ bsad par gyis bsad par gyis/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ byed du chug byed du chug gardzadza ya gardzadza ya/ sgrogs sgrogs/ tardzadza ya tardzadza ya/ bsdigs bsdigs/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ skom shig skom shig sap+ta sā ga rā na/ rgya mtsho bdun po rnams/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ chings chings/ nā ga aṣ+ṭa kā na/ klu brgyad po rnams/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sha trū na

zung zung dgra bo rnams/ ha hā hi hī hu hū he hai ho hau ham̐ haḥ phaṭa khos shig swā hā/ legs par sbyin/ yab kyi rtsa sngags so// oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra bkra shis lha 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o// oṃ badz+ra kartā ri he badz+ra ya rdo rje gri gug kyai rdo rje la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o// zhes snang*/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i gsungs las/ dmigs pa ni yum sogs la/ dmigs pa ni yum gyi skabs su am̐ gi sngags phreng sngon po byung nas sngar bzhin du 'khor ba dang*/ gau rī la yum gyi thugs ka'i am̐ las/ oṃ āḥgam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā'i sngags phreng kha dog nag po thol gyi byung*/ yum gyi zhal nas byung rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ las sngags phreng byung*/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar song*/ thugs ka'i am̐ la thim pas bar ma chad par 'khor ba'i 'od zer gau rī la phog pas gau rī bdag gi dbang du 'dus par bsam/ des mtshon nas tsau rī la sngags phreng dmar po/ bai tā lī la ser po/ ghasma rī la ljang gu sogs lha so so'i kha dog dang mthun par 'od zer dmar po lcags sgrog sgril ba lta bu 'phro bzhin pas bar ma chad par 'khor ba la sems gtad cing sngags bzla ba yin gsung*/ oṃ āḥ.am̐ ām̐/ gsang rgyun las am̐ ām̐ sogs klad kor rnams la nga 'bod dgos/ iṃ īṃ/ uṃ āṃ/ ṛṃ ṝṃ/ l̥ṃ l̥̄ṃ/ eṃ aiṃ/ oṃ auṃ/ am̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'di bzlas pa'i skabs su ma chad par dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de nyid lnga spel dgos par bshad cing*/ lhag par rje btsun rin po che'i mngon rtogs su gsungs pa ltar/ rjes 'jug gi yig cha tshad ldan kun nas bshad pas ma chad pa gal che'o// rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi phreng sngags so// oṃ āḥ.am̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

oṃ āḥnam̐ badz+ra nai rāt+ma rdo rje bdag med ma/ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ bdag med ma'i'o// oṃ āḥgam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsung rgyun la/ ga la nga*/ gau rī'o/ oṃ āḥtsaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ tsa la na/ tsau rī'o// oṃ āḥbam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ba la ma/ bai tā li'o// oṃ āḥgham̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gha la nga*/ ghasma rī'o/ /oṃ āḥpam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ pa la ma/ puk+ka sī'o// oṃ āḥsham̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ sha la nga*/ sha ba rī'o// oṃ āḥlam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ la la ma/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī'o// oṃ āḥḍam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ḍa la na 'bod dgos/ ḍom+bhi nī'o// 'di dag gi klad kor la brda sprod pa dag gi lugs la/ rjes su nga ro sde pa la/ rang rang sde pa'i lnga par bklag ya sogs brgyad la nga ru'o// zhes bod par bshad kyang 'dir 'khrul pa med pa'i zhal rgyun las ji ltar byon pa nyid rtsis su mdzad pa yin no// zhes paṇ+ḍi ta nā gārdzu nas bshad pa ltar mtshal bris mchan rnams drin chen rdo rje 'chang de nyid la zhal spod zhus pa yin no// rgyas par byed na/ oṃ āḥgam̐ badz+ra gau rī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs sa bon gyi rtsar ming bcug par byas la bzla'o// de nas skabs 'dir gtor ma mi btong na/ rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis dang smon lam rnam par dag pa btab la spyod lam la 'jug par bya'o// zhes dang*/ tshar chen rin po che'i gsung nor phreng las/ bzlas pa'i mjug tu gsang ba kun rgyan las/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par mdzad du gsol/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum bzla/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad la phog pas de thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/

de dur khrod brgyad la= de thun mong ma yin pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo la= de gzhal yas khang la= de lha mo brgyad la= de zhal brgyad la= zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la= yum yab la thim/ rang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur// ༈ /gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gtor ma du yod kyang byin rlabs dus gcig la byas chog pas/ gtor ma rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ de ma 'byor na chu gtsang mas sbyangs la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ swa bhā shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du shar du go las ba glang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ dbus su na las mi'i sha/ sha de rnams re re'i steng du yang bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa ni/ shar du bh+rūm̐ las dri chen/ lhor ām̐ las rak+ta/ nub tu dz+rīṃ las byang sems/ byang du kham̐ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du/ shar du bh+rūm̐ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor am̐ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du kham̐ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon skor gyis/ a ā/ i ī/ a ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ am̐ aḥ g.yas skor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo thur du lta ba/

de'i steng du ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros rlung gi ba dan la phog pas/ rlung g.yos me sbar bas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams skol zhing 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song ste/ oṃ dang rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams/ he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon nas rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa la thim pas rdo rje ljid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te kha dog dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥzhes lan gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar e e e las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum sum brtsegs kyi nang du pam̐ pam̐ pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa re re/ steng gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su sku rdo rje/ shar du dbang phyug chen po/ lhor lha'i dbang po/ nub tu tshangs pa/ byang du khyab 'jug shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ lho nub tu tshogs kyi bdag po/ nub byang du bh+riṃ gi ri ti/ byang shar du gzhon nu karti ka ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ bar gyi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la hūm̐ dgu yongs su gyur pa las/

dbus su kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang shar du dbang ldan te/ phyogs skyong brgyad po thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ 'og gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la/ āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong*/ nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du nor rgyas/ shar lhor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du pad+ma/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ 'byung po nyer bzhi po 'di dag thams cad kyang pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o// rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ steng gi lha tshogs thams cad lha chen brgyad la bsdus/ sa steng na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs skyong brgyad la bsdus/ sa 'og na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad klu chen brgyad la bsdus te gnyis su med par gyur/ de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ yang*/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyai rdo rje lha dgu sku gsung thugs rdo rje lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pā ri wā ra kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ

zhes pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ de nas/ oṃ e h+ye hi zhes pa nas/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra we sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bai tā lī bhan+dha baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pas thams cad kyang ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rig ma dang lha mo/ khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// zhes sogs lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis// khyed kyis 'di la dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis gau rī dang puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha wa rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ bai tā lī dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang ḍom+bhi nī la 'od dpag med/ phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas/ oṃ bha ga wan zhes pa nas kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta oṃ badz+ra ni ri hūm̐ kham̐ swā hā/ zhes sogs kyis chu bzhi phul/ de nas lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje nas 'bru tsam gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer byung nas gtor ma'i bcud drangs shing gsol nas mnyes par bsams la/

pad skor bya zhing*/ ngag tu/ oṃ bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pā ri wā ra kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta oṃ in+d+ra/ dza ma/ dza la/ dzak+kha/ bhū ta/ bha hi/ ba u/ rak+ṣa/ tsan+da/ sudz+dza/ mā da/ pap+pa/ ta la pa ta la/ aṣ+ṭa sap+pa swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ bhuñja/ dzi gha/ phul+la/ dhup+pa/ maṃ sa/ piṅga/ am+bha/ sap+pa/ kadz+dza/ sā dā/ khaṇ+ḍi khu ni/ phai ṭa/ ga da/ oṃ ā ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dhārma ṇāṃ/ ād+ya nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun la sogs pas dbul lo// de nas/ oṃ bha ga wān zhes pa nas/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhūp+pe/ ā lo ke/ ghan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas phyi mchod/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang gi bdud rtsis kyang mchod/ de nas dril bu gsil zhing*/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs zhes sogs dang*/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag= /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med// rin chen mkha' 'gror= /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che// mi rtog ye shes nam mkha'i dbyings// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// pad+ma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// zhes pas bstod/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i=

/'byung po'i= /yi dwags= /sha za'i= /smyo byed= brjed byed= /mkha' 'gro'i= /ma mo'i= /de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba= sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /bar phrin las gzhol bar bya'o// bar 'dir gur mgon lcam dral la gtor 'bul zhig mchis pa ma bris rung spro na myur mgyogs pho nya sogs gtor 'bul rgyas bsdus skabs su gang babs bya'o// de nas gtor ma gang yod phul tshar ba dang*/ kol+la i reṭa ṭhi a bo la/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko lā/ gha ne kri bi ṭa ho bādz+dza i/ ka ru ṇe ki a i na ro lā/ ta hiṃ ba la khā dz+dza i/ ga ḍheṃ ma a ṇā pidz+dza a i/ ha le kā liñja ra pa ṇi a i/ dun+du ra bādz+dzi a i/ tsa u sa ma kats+tshu rī sih+la/ kāspu ra lā i a i/ ma la in+dha ṇa sa liñja/ ta hiṃ bha ru khā i a i/ phreṃ kha ṇa ka ṭa ka ran ta/ shud+dha a shud+dha na mu ṇi a i/ ni rāṃ su aṃ ge tsa ṭā wi/ ta hiṃ dza sa rā wa pa ṇi a i/ ma la a dze kun+du ru pā ṭa i/ ḍin+ḍi ma ta hiṇ+ṇa badz+dzi a i/ zhes dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o// de yis nye bar bsten pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o// dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o// zhes dang*/

rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// smyo med kyai yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rje ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med pa// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces smon lam btab bo// de nas yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod la nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod do// ༈ /kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ rang kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bsam te/ lte ba nas me sbar te lha mchod pa'i bsam pas bza'o// lhag ma oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba ling ta bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin no// 'di ni kha zas kyi rnal 'byor 'bring du bya ba yin la/ rgyas bsdus gnyis byed par 'dod na mngon par rtogs pa rgyas pa las shes par bya'o// rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor ni 'dir ma bris so// ༈ /nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ lha mo brgyad zhal brgyad la bsdu ba'i bar gong ltar byas la/ de nas yum yang yab la/ yab snying ga'i hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ zhabs kyu la/ de khog pa la/ de nā da'i bar du thim zhing*/ de'ang mi dmigs pa'i ngang du nyal lo// ༈ /ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ nangs par tho rangs skad cig tsam gyis dpal kyai rdo rje yab yum du ldang ngo*// ༈ /khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ tho rangs bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro na khrus bya/ mi 'gro na ma byas kyang nyes pa med do// byed par spro na/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha spyan drangs pa la sogs dbang gi skabs ltar byas la/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba spyi bo nas blugs shing dbang bskur bar bsams te/ dngos su rang gis bum chus khrus bya zhing*/ sems kyis spyi gtsug nas byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun zhugs pas dbang bzhi pa thob dri ma bzhi dag par bsam zhing khrus bya'o// de ni dbang bskur gyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ sgrub pa'i cho ga rnams bsre ba dang dbu rgyan bsam mi dgos// ༈ /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad dpal kyai rdo rjer mos pa byas la spyod lam bya'o// mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor bstan zin to// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu'i sgo nas nyin mtshan khor yug tu nyams su blangs pas dpal kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang myur du 'thob par nyid do// ༈ /'di ni mngon par rtogs pa 'bring du bya ba yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du thams cad mkhyen pa snyigs dus kyi rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po'i gsung gi bdud rtsi yun ring du bsten pa bya bral ba dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis las dang po pa rnams la 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir bris pa yin no// 'di dag gi go rgyu dang mtha' dpyad pa rnams rje bla mas mdzad pa'i bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer du shes par bya'o// 'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na bla ma dang yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol lo// bdag cag rnams lam sgrub pa'i bar du gcod pa zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ 'dis bstan pa dang sems can thams cad la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig ces mngon rtogs bya bral mar grags pa/ rje btsun e wam̐ pa'i gdan rabs dang po rje sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa la rdo rje 'chang char chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung nyi zer nor phreng dang*/ drin chen rdo rje 'chang gi zhal rgyun gtsos/

rang lugs kha'u pa'i bla ma gong ma'i dgongs don ltar/ bklag chog tu bkod pa ni/ pha rgan rigs kun bdag po gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang gis mkhyen brtse nus pa chen pos skye ba'i phreng bar rjes su bzung ba'i bka' drin las snyan brgyud slob bshad la byed pa rgyu mthun gyi bag chags rang byung du brtas pa theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa rgyal rigs āḥming gis rang gzhan gsung ngag nyams khrid skyong ba rnams kyi kha ton 'jug bder bris pa dge'o// swa sti/ dus gsum bde gshegs bgrod pa'i shul chen po// thun min mngon lus zab mo'i par gzhi'i 'phrul// 'byed pa'i yon sbyar rnam 'dren a nan+das// rgyun gyi dbang por legs par bskrun mdzad dges// rgyal bstan spyi dang gsang chen slob bshad kyi// ring srol de 'dzin yongs brtan khrims ldan sde// bslab gsum gyis brgyan yongs su 'phel ba dang*// 'gro kun bde ldan rnam mkhyen myur thob shog /ces pa'ang lha rigs in+d+ra'i ming mtha' can gyis smras pa sarba dza ga taṃ/ par 'di shrī na lan+d+ra'i bco brgyad gsang chen pho brang na bzhugs// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
